## Languages and node list updates

- Added Simplified Chinese and Russian interfaces, a four-language selector, localized controls and documentation updates.
- Fixed stale All nodes results after Save & Apply by rebuilding the node cache from committed settings, including when a fixed node is selected or the service is disabled.
- Fixed the node count when the last node is removed.
- Renamed the link import action to Import share links and moved the automatic selection explanation into the question-mark help beside its heading.
- Clarified the VLESS encryption label and restricted flow to supported choices with a clear disabled option.
- Removed hamza and diacritics from Persian interface and diagnostic text.

Validation includes real router add/delete tests in English and Persian, Chinese and Russian rendering checks, help interactions in both English and Persian, translation coverage and formatting checks, and node-cache reload regression tests.
